title.rendered: Krebs on Security has been added as a Link

content.rendered:
It’s been 9 months since a link has been added to the CCRA website and it is with pleasure that we now add a link to “Krebs on Security”.

Brian Krebs worked as a reporter for The Washington Post from 1995 to 2009, authoring more than 1,300 blog posts for the Security Fix blog, as well as hundreds of stories for washingtonpost.com and The Washington Post newspaper, including eight front-page stories in the dead-tree edition and a Post Magazine cover piece on botnet operators. In 2014, he was profiled in The New York Times, Business Week and by Poynter.org. His website is highly regarded for its clearly written stories on the latest common senses Internet security topics.

For more information please use the following link Krebs on Security.
